newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil April Fipe inflation at 0.64 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil April Fipe inflation at 0.64 pct.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 0.64 percent in April versus 0.21 percent in March, a Fipe official said.
Fipe inflation index coordinator Juarez Rizzieri, said rising clothing prices due to the new line of winter garments offset price declines in food, transportation and personal expenses.
Rizzieri said May inflation would likely come in at about 0.50 percent.
Fipe released the following breakdown of its weighted inflation index for January 16 through February 14:
- Food: -0.37 pct drop in the month
- Housing: 0.47 pct rise in the month
- Transportation: -0.07 drop rise in the month
- Personal expenses: -0.10 pct rise in the month
- Clothing: 7.07 pct drop in the month
- Health care: 1.04 pct rise in the month
- Education: 0.21 pct rise in the month
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures weekly.
